lines.japanese: 次に目覚めたときは、きのうと同じ洗面所にいた。
lines.english: When I woke again, I was in the same washroom as yesterday.

lines.japanese: 一瞬で現実に引きずりだされる≪スクランブル≫とは違った、ゆっくりと世界の一部に同調してゆく感覚。
lines.english: This was different from a *Scramble*, which hauled me into reality in an instant: the slow sensation of synchronizing with one small part of the world.

lines.japanese: 十本の指が、よし、動く。
lines.english: Ten fingers. Good. All moving.

lines.japanese: しかし時刻を確認した俺は思わず眉をしかめさせた。
lines.english: Then I checked the time and couldn't help scowling.

lines.japanese: 「ああッ！？」
lines.english: “What the hell?!”

lines.japanese: いいかげん見慣れてきた洋食屋の前、俺は腰をぐいと回しながら体の馴染みを確認していた。反対側にもう一度ぐい。
lines.english: Outside the Western-style restaurant I’d come to know, I gave my waist a hard twist, testing how the body felt. Then another in the opposite direction.

lines.japanese: いまごろきっと、あの小娘がブーたれて待ってる。
lines.english: By now that little brat would be waiting, sulking her head off.

lines.japanese: 二度目の漫画喫茶に行く約束。集合場所はヤナポリ広場。待ち合わせ時刻は２２時３０分。
lines.english: We had promised a second trip to the manga café. Yanapoli Plaza. Ten-thirty.

lines.japanese: そして現在の時刻が２２時３５分。
lines.english: The time now: ten thirty-five.

lines.japanese: 遅れたのは俺のせいじゃない。時間もロクに守らない鷲介が悪いんだ。
lines.english: Not my fault. Blame Shusuke, who couldn’t keep an appointment to save his life.

lines.japanese: おまけにあの野郎、何を入れたんだかスポーツバッグがやけに重い。さっきは大した相手でもないのに≪スクランブル≫かけるし、糞ワシめ、やりたい放題じゃねえか。
lines.english: And what the hell had he packed in this sports bag? It weighed a ton. First he called a *Scramble* over some nobody, and now this. That goddamn Shusuke was doing whatever he pleased.

lines.japanese: 俺は舌を鳴らすと、ヤナポリ広場に向かってゆっくりと歩きはじめた。
lines.english: I clicked my tongue and began a slow walk toward Yanapoli Plaza.

lines.japanese: いつになく寒い夜だった。
lines.english: The night was colder than usual.

lines.japanese: 俺は駅前のスクランブル交差点で信号につかまった。俺の周りに鬱陶しいぐらいの人の壁ができる。
lines.english: The light caught me at the scramble crossing outside the station. An irritating wall of humanity closed in around me.

lines.japanese: 外から見れば俺もその群れの一部のはずだが、ひとりで立っている俺には、この喧しい騒めきが同類だとは思われない。
lines.english: From outside, I must have looked like part of the herd. But standing there alone, I couldn't believe this noisy rabble belonged to the same species as me.

lines.japanese: 呆けたツラで信号機が青になるのを待っていた。すぐ後ろで学生服の小娘どもが、オトコがどーだスイーツがこーだとギャーギャーうるさい。天下の公道ではしゃぐな。店入れ店。
lines.english: I waited blankly for the signal to turn green. Right behind me, girls in school uniforms shrieked about boys and desserts. Don't carry on in the middle of a public road. Go find a restaurant.

lines.japanese: 信号が青になると、小娘どもは「一番遅せーやつがクレープおごりー」などと黄色い声をあげながら横断歩道を突きぬけていった。幸せでいいねえと思う。
lines.english: When the light changed, the girls tore across the crosswalk, squealing, ‘Last one there buys the crêpes!’ Must be nice, being happy.

lines.japanese: 交差点を渡りきった先のヤナポリ広場では、いつかのギャル男たちが、今日も今日とて往来の女に声をかけていた。
lines.english: Across the intersection in Yanapoli Plaza, the pickup artists from last time were once again calling out to every woman who passed.

lines.japanese: 前回はずいぶん妥協して狩りを成功させていたが、今回は身の程もわきまえずに、ハイレベルの制服美少女へ挑んでいるようだ。
lines.english: Last time they'd lowered their sights considerably and brought the hunt to a successful end. Tonight, with no sense of their station, they appeared to be challenging a top-tier beauty in a school uniform.

lines.japanese: 俺はやつらが集まっているベンチの隣りに腰を下ろす。もはや男たちは頼み口調だった。
lines.english: I sat on the bench beside theirs. By now the men had resorted to begging.

lines.japanese: ん？　遠目に横顔チラリ程度しか見てないけど、そんなか？　そんなにも美少女だったか？
lines.english: Hm? I'd only caught a flash of her profile from a distance, but really? Was she *that* pretty?

lines.japanese: 気になってさりげなく背筋と首を伸ばした。男たちの輪の中に、ブレザー姿の香田亜衣がひとり──
lines.english: Curious, I casually straightened my back and craned my neck. There in the ring of men stood Ai Koda, alone in her blazer—

lines.japanese: ──え、香田？
lines.english: —Wait. Koda?

lines.japanese: 「あー、隼人君！」
lines.english: “Oh! Hayato!”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 香田と香田を取りまく男たちの目が一斉にこちらを向いた。
lines.english: Koda and every man surrounding her turned toward me at once.

lines.japanese: 「あはっ、友達きたから。じゃねー」
lines.english: “Aha, my friend's here. Later.”

lines.japanese: ひらひらと手を振る亜衣が、男たちの輪から抜けでてきて俺の前に立った。
lines.english: Ai waved airily, slipped free of the circle, and stopped before me.

lines.japanese: こいつの制服姿を見るのは、初めてだったかもしれない。一瞬ハイレベルな美少女などと錯覚してしまったのは、きっとそのせいだろう。
lines.english: Maybe this was my first time seeing her in uniform. That had to be why I'd mistaken her, for one fleeting instant, for some top-tier beauty.

lines.japanese: 「お、おお。悪りい、遅れて──」
lines.english: “H-hey. Sorry I’m late—”

lines.japanese: 「よかったあ！　もー今日は来ないのかと思ってぃん、ありがちゅー！」
lines.english: “Thank goodness! I thought you weren't coming today. Thank yooou!”

lines.japanese: 遅刻したことを咎められもせず、しかも礼まで言われてしまった。
lines.english: No complaint about my being late. She'd actually thanked me.

lines.japanese: ギャル男たちはしばらく不躾な視線で俺の全身を舐めたおしていたが、やがて負け惜しみじみた笑みを残して別のベンチへ移っていった。
lines.english: The pickup artists spent a while raking impudent eyes over my whole body. At last they left us with the sour smiles of losers pretending not to care and moved to another bench.

lines.japanese: 「も、超しつこいし。隼人君がもう少し遅かったら、結構しんどかったかも」
lines.english: “God, they were relentless. If you'd been any later, that might've gotten pretty rough.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ……香田ってモテキャラだったっけ」
lines.english: “Wait... Was Koda always the hot-and-popular type?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、あのひとら、どーせ誰にでも声かけてんでしょ」
lines.english: “Those guys probably hit on everybody.”

lines.japanese: ソーダ色の棒付きキャンディをくるくる回す。
lines.english: She twirled a soda-blue lollipop.

lines.japanese: 「つか、なんで制服？」
lines.english: “More to the point, why are you in uniform?”

lines.japanese: なんでってこともないか。水泳選手になぜ水着なのか聞くようなもんだ。
lines.english: Though why ask why? It was like asking a swimmer why she wore a swimsuit.

lines.japanese: 前開きにしたブレザー。ブラウスのゆるい襟元で、ネクタイが校則違反的なぶら下がり方をしていた。
lines.english: Her blazer hung open. At the loose neck of her blouse, her tie dangled in flagrant violation of school rules.

lines.japanese: 「あっ、やっぱ気付いたあ？」
lines.english: “Oh! You noticed?”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃ気付くだろ」
lines.english: “Of course I noticed.”

lines.japanese: サボり魔の水泳選手が珍しく水着だったらそりゃあ。
lines.english: If a swimmer notorious for skipping practice actually turned up in a swimsuit, of course I'd notice.

lines.japanese: 「くふ、隼人君こーゆーの好きそうだもんね。制服とかナチュラルメイクとか」
lines.english: “Heh. You seem like you'd be into this, Hayato. Uniforms, natural makeup, that kind of thing.”

lines.japanese: 「ねーよ。だから俺の好みは、妖艶な色香のただよう女豹のような女なんだよ」
lines.english: “Hell no. My type is a woman like a panther, dripping with dangerous allure.”

lines.japanese: 「やっばー、なんか熱視線感じるんですけどキャハー！」
lines.english: “Oh my God, I can feel that burning gaze! Eee!”

lines.japanese: やつは奇声をあげながら、怪鳥のようにブレザーをはたはた煽いだ。やばい、ギャル男たちの熱視線で頭のネジが溶けちゃったみたいだ。
lines.english: Shrieking, she flapped her blazer like some monstrous bird. Bad news. The pickup artists' burning stares had apparently melted the screws in her head.

lines.japanese: 「あとコレとか？」
lines.english: “How about these?”

lines.japanese: 手術前のお医者さんみたいに、肘から先を掲げてみせる。いつか見た装飾過多な凶器から、デコレーションが一掃されていた。爪の下のピンクの肌が、冬の空気によく馴染んでいる。
lines.english: She raised her hands from the elbows like a surgeon preparing to operate. The decorations had been stripped from those gaudy weapons I remembered. The pink flesh beneath her nails belonged naturally in the winter air.

lines.japanese: 「どーよ」
lines.english: “Well?”

lines.japanese: 手の甲を二度三度とひるがえす。きーらーきーらー光らないー。
lines.english: She flipped her hands over, once, twice, three times. Twinkle, twinkle—not a sparkle.

lines.japanese: 「おっ、爪切り見つかったんだ」
lines.english: “Oh. You found your nail clippers.”

lines.japanese: 「爪切りなかったわけじゃなーい！」
lines.english: “It wasn't because I'd lost my nail clippers!”

lines.japanese: ひらひら回っていた手が、×字に交差して襲いかかってきた。ささめ雪のようなクロスチョップ。
lines.english: The fluttering hands crossed into an X and swooped at me: a cross-chop light as powder snow.

lines.japanese: 「ってゆーか、もともとチップだし。男の子にはワカラン？」
lines.english: “I mean, they were press-ons to begin with. Is that too much for a boy to understand?”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　テメなに勝ちほこってんだ、じゃおまえらカブトムシの捕り方とか知ってんのか。テキサスクローバーホールドのかけ方とか知らねーだろ。スーパーカー消しゴムぶっつけるぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Huh? What’re you so smug about? Do you girls know how to catch a rhinoceros beetle? Bet you can’t apply a Texas Cloverleaf. I’ll peg you with a supercar eraser, damn it.”

lines.japanese: それから俺は、ガキのころ読んだ熱い少年漫画についてたっぷり語ろうと思ったが、夢と浪漫と冒険心を解せぬ女という生き物によって止められた。
lines.english: I was ready to tell her all about the red-blooded boys' manga of my childhood, but the female organism—incapable of comprehending dreams, romance, or the spirit of adventure—cut me off.

lines.japanese: 「いいから、なんか食べに行こーよ。こないだ隼人君の言ってたラーメン屋さんとか」
lines.english: “Never mind that. Let's go get something to eat. How about that ramen place you mentioned the other day?”

lines.japanese: 「は？　なんで。今日の目的、漫喫だろ」
lines.english: “What? Why? We came for the manga café.”

lines.japanese: たしかメンマのラーメンは美味い。食わせてスゲエと言わせたい。でも、俺やメンマやプラチナなんかの中に香田が入るって絵ヅラは、いまいちピンと来なかった。
lines.english: Menma's ramen really was good. I wanted to feed it to her and make her say so. But the picture of Koda sitting there among Menma, Platinum, and me refused to come together in my head.

lines.japanese: 「おし、漫喫いこ漫喫」
lines.english: “Right. Let's go to the manga café.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、その前にどっか寄ったっていーじゃん」
lines.english: “What? We can stop somewhere first.”

lines.japanese: 「やだよ、金ねえし。さっさと行くぞ」
lines.english: “No. I'm broke. Come on.”

lines.japanese: 「いーじゃんいーじゃん。じゃさ、またあの階段でぼーっとしよっか」
lines.english: “Why not? Oh, then we could sit around on those stairs again.”

lines.japanese: 「やだよ、寒みいし。さっさと行くぞ」
lines.english: “No. It's cold. Come on.”

lines.japanese: 「あー！　じゃさじゃさ、あったかいの買ってきてあげる、ちょっと待ってて」
lines.english: “Oh! Then I'll buy you something warm. Wait here.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だから漫喫行けばあったかいし、飲みモンも食いモンも……おいコラ、待て、ひとの話聞け」
lines.english: “But the manga café is warm, and it has drinks and food... Hey, wait. Listen when somebody talks to you.”

lines.japanese: だが香田は俺の制止を無視して、さっさと駅ビルの方へ走っていってしまった。
lines.english: But Koda ignored me and hurried off toward the station building.

lines.japanese: だから。
lines.english: I mean it.

lines.japanese: だからやめてくれよ、そういうの。
lines.english: Stop doing things like that.

lines.japanese: そんな時間稼ぎまでしたって楽しくないだろ、俺といるの。
lines.english: Stalling for time wouldn’t make being with me any more fun.

lines.japanese: すでに立ちあがって歩きはじめていたが、ひとりになってしまったので、ふたたびベンチに腰を落とした。
lines.english: I'd already stood and started walking, but now that she had left me alone, I sank back onto the bench.

lines.japanese: 白い息がのぼる。後ろでは例のギャル男たちが騒いでいた。まだいたのか。この寒い中、精が出ること──
lines.english: White breath climbed into the air. Behind me, the same pickup artists were making a racket. Still here? Such admirable dedication in this cold—

lines.japanese: 「ああキショウ、上手くいかねーなァ。クソ寒みーし、今日はもう帰ッかあ」
lines.english: “Aw, shit. Nothing's working tonight. Fucking freezing, too. Let's pack it in.”

lines.japanese: ──ん？　なんだ、もう上がんのか。
lines.english: —Hm? Giving up already?

lines.japanese: だが、やつらの気持ちも分かる。今日の冷え込みは本当に厳しい。
lines.english: Still, I knew how they felt. It was seriously cold tonight.

lines.japanese: １１月も間もなく終わり。すっかり冬の気候だ。俺はファーの襟を立てて、亀のように顔を埋めた。
lines.english: November was nearly over. Winter had settled in for good. I turned up my fur collar and tucked my face inside like a turtle.

lines.japanese: 「つかさ、さっきのコすげえな。何分待ってた？　ありえんでしょ」
lines.english: “Seriously, that girl before was something else. How long was she waiting? That's not normal.”

lines.japanese: 「俺ら一時間前に来たけど、それより先にいたもんな。根性あるわ。鉄の気迫だわ」
lines.english: “We got here an hour ago, and she was already here. That's grit. An iron will.”

lines.japanese: 「この寒い中、よくやるよな。軽く執念入ってんし。マジあそこまでいくとキメぇよ。通称ＭＡＫだよ」
lines.english: “Standing around that long in this cold? She's getting obsessive. Once it goes that far, it's just plain creepy. That's WAC: Waiting Around Creepily.”

lines.japanese: やつらは「そのわり彼氏ショボかったよな」とオチを付けてウシャウシャ笑った。
lines.english: They capped it with, ‘And her boyfriend wasn't even much to look at,’ then guffawed together.

lines.japanese: いったい誰の話をしてるんだろう。
lines.english: Who on earth were they talking about?

lines.japanese: 俺はアルバトロスの巨大ディスプレイを見上げた。画面下のテロップによれば、ただいまの気温６度。
lines.english: I looked up at the Albatross’s giant screen. According to the crawl beneath it, the temperature was six degrees Celsius.

lines.japanese: 凍った溜息を吐きながら頭を落とすと、足元にはストロー状の棒がいくつも散らばっていた。
lines.english: I let out a frozen sigh and lowered my head. Several strawlike sticks lay scattered at my feet.

lines.japanese: なんだこれ。キャンディ・スティックか。ああ、きっと誰かがここで棒付き飴をたくさん舐めまくったんだろう。ずいぶん暇なやつもいたもんだ。
lines.english: What were these? Lollipop sticks? Oh, somebody must have sat here sucking down a whole pile of them. Some people had a remarkable amount of time to kill.

lines.japanese: <8>\「れもんてぃー！」
lines.english: “Lemon teeea!”

lines.japanese: 「あっち！」
lines.english: “Hot!”

lines.japanese: 額に焼けるような熱さが触れて、思わず全身で跳ねおきた。香田がずんぐりサイズのペットボトルをよこして俺の隣りに座る。
lines.english: Scalding heat touched my forehead and my whole body sprang upright. Koda handed me a stubby plastic bottle and sat beside me.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、ども……いくら？」
lines.english: “Oh. Thanks... How much?”

lines.japanese: 「いいよ。おごったる」
lines.english: “Don't worry. My treat.”
“No, I'll pay. A hundred and twenty yen?”

lines.japanese: 「いいってば。じゃあ次は隼人君がおごってよ」
lines.english: “I said it's fine. You can treat me next time.”

lines.japanese: 次があると確信してるのか、確信にしたくてそんなことを言うのか。
lines.english: Was she certain there would be a next time? Or had she said it to make certain there would be?

lines.japanese: 俺は意地でも立て替え代を返したかったが、不幸にも財布の中の小銭が足らなかった。
lines.english: I meant to pay her back if it killed me. Unfortunately, my wallet held too little change.

lines.japanese: 「あれ、どしたん？　あ、もしかしてレモンティー嫌い？　コンポタと取っかえよっか」
lines.english: “What's wrong? Oh, do you hate lemon tea? Want to trade for my corn soup?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、こっちでいい。ども」
lines.english: “No, this is fine. Thanks.”

lines.japanese: オレンジキャップをねじ切って飲んだ。熱さが喉を刺す。
lines.english: I twisted off the orange cap and drank. Heat stabbed my throat.

lines.japanese: 香田はコーンポタージュのホット缶を両手で挟み、その温度を楽しむようにころころ転がしていた。
lines.english: Koda cupped the hot can of creamy corn soup in both hands and rolled it to and fro, savoring the warmth.

lines.japanese: 「あんさ」
lines.english: “Listen.”

lines.japanese: 「うん？」
lines.english: “Mm?”

lines.japanese: 「きょう遅れてごめん」
lines.english: “Sorry I was late today.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　ああ、なに、いいよそんなの。ぜんぜん待ってないし」
lines.english: “What? Oh, that. Don't worry about it. I barely waited.”

lines.japanese: 「そう」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。てゆっか、実は私も遅刻しちったから、五分ぐらいしか待ってないし」
lines.english: “Yeah. Actually, I was late too, so I only waited about five minutes.”

lines.japanese: そう言ってやつはプルタブを開けた。ちびりと啜る。俺もレモンティーを飲んだ。甘すぎる。もっと酸っぱくていいのに。
lines.english: She pulled the tab. Took a tiny sip. I drank my lemon tea. Too sweet. It ought to have been sourer.

lines.japanese: 「そいぇばさー」
lines.english: “Come to think of it...”

lines.japanese: 「あー？」
lines.english: “Yeah?”

lines.japanese: ふたり顔も合わせずに口を開く。
lines.english: We spoke without looking at one another.

lines.japanese: 「隼人君、遠くに行くってどの辺？」
lines.english: “When you say you're going far away, where do you mean?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ……分かんね」
lines.english: “Oh... I don’t know.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、なにそれ」
lines.english: “What? What does that mean?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、隠してるとかじゃなくて。ほんと、まだよく分かってねーの。でもすっげえ遠く。それは確か」
lines.english: “I'm not keeping it secret. I really don't know yet. But very far away. That much is certain.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: ハヤトお兄さんはお星様になるのよ。子供じゃあるまいに、そんな説明で納得できるはずはない。しかしやつはそれ以上追及してこなかった。
lines.english: *Hayato’s going to be a star in the sky.* She wasn’t a child; that explanation couldn’t possibly satisfy her. Yet she didn’t press.

lines.japanese: 「分かったら連絡先教えてね」
lines.english: “When you find out, tell me how I can reach you.”

lines.japanese: 俺は曖昧に頷いた。
lines.english: I nodded vaguely.

lines.japanese: 「隼人君、ケータイ持つ予定ないの？」
lines.english: “Are you ever planning to get a cell phone?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、ないねえ」
lines.english: “No. Probably not.”

lines.japanese: 「そか。じゃ手紙書くね」
lines.english: “Okay. Then I'll write you letters.”
“Mm.”

lines.japanese: 仰向いてレモンティーを口いっぱいに溜めた。熱ち、熱ちいよ、馬鹿。
lines.english: I tipped my head back and filled my mouth with lemon tea. Hot—too hot, idiot.

lines.japanese: 「あ、そだ隼人君、写メ撮っていい？」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Hayato, can I take a phone pic?”

lines.japanese: 「は？　なんで」
lines.english: “What? Why?”

lines.japanese: 写真は苦手だ。嫌いと言ってもいい。
lines.english: I was no good with photographs. I might as well say I hated them.

lines.japanese: 「そんなの忘れないために決まってんじゃん」
lines.english: “So I don't forget you. Obviously.”

lines.japanese: だけど楽しそうに携帯電話を操作する香田の勢いに呑まれて、俺は拒否できなかった。
lines.english: But Koda worked her phone with such cheerful momentum that I couldn't bring myself to refuse.

lines.japanese: 「うりゃ！」
lines.english: “Take that!”

lines.japanese: 間抜けな電子音が鳴った。
lines.english: A foolish electronic sound chirped.

lines.japanese: 「よし、ないすショット。墓まで持ってこ」
lines.english: “Perfect. Nice shot. This one's coming to the grave with me.”

lines.japanese: そこに映っているのは、ポーズも愛敬もない半目の俺だろう。
lines.english: The picture probably showed me with my eyes half closed, without a pose or a scrap of charm.

lines.japanese: 「いきなり撮んなよ」
lines.english: “Don’t take it without warning.”

lines.japanese: 「いきなりじゃなきゃ、どうせ逃げるくせに」
lines.english: “If I warned you, you’d run away.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、たしかに」
lines.english: “True.”

lines.japanese: よく分かってる。思わず吹きだしてしまった。
lines.english: She knew me well. A laugh escaped me before I could stop it.

lines.japanese: 「あーそだ、ついでにここで見てくー？」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Since we're here, want to look at it now?”

lines.japanese: 香田がいちど畳んだケータイをふたたび開く。漫画喫茶で見るはずだった例のページを呼びだすみたいだ。
lines.english: Koda flipped her clamshell open again. Apparently she meant to bring up the page we'd planned to view at the manga café.

lines.japanese: 「あれ、いいの。なんか、自分のケータイでは二度と見たくないとか言ってなかったっけ」
lines.english: “Wait, is that okay? Didn't you say you never wanted to look at it on your own phone again?”

lines.japanese: 「んー、そうなんだけどー。でも隼人君はさっさと見たいんでしょ？」
lines.english: “Well, yeah. But you want to see it as soon as possible, don’t you?”

lines.japanese: ああ、俺の機嫌をうかがってるのか。意地らしいな。申しわけなくて涙が出そうだ。
lines.english: Oh. She was testing my mood. How touching. I could have wept with guilt.

lines.japanese: 「なんかいま雰囲気いいし、この小さい画面をふたりで一緒に覗くのも風情があると思わん？」
lines.english: “The mood's kind of nice right now, too. Don't you think there's a certain charm to both of us huddling over this tiny screen?”

lines.japanese: 思わない。
lines.english: No.

lines.japanese: 「お、更新されてる。んー、なんだろこの画像……」
lines.english: “Oh, it's been updated. Hmm. What's this picture...?”

lines.japanese: 例のページが表示されたようだ。横から覗きこむと、携帯電話の小さい画面いっぱいに写真……女の写真らしきものが映っていた。
lines.english: The page seemed to load. Peering in from the side, I saw a photograph fill the phone's tiny screen... apparently a photograph of a girl.

lines.japanese: 俺はそれを見て絶句する。
lines.english: The sight struck me dumb.

lines.japanese: 「んん？　ちょおイミフだし。私が見たときはこんな写真なかったんだけど」
lines.english: “Huh? This makes zero sense. That picture wasn't there when I looked before.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで……これ……」
lines.english: “Why... is this...”

lines.japanese: 「ん、どしたん？」
lines.english: “Hm? What’s wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「これは……こいつは……」
lines.english: “This is... She’s...”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　なに、隼人君知り合い？」
lines.english: “What? Hayato, do you know her?”

lines.japanese: 横で亜衣がなにか言っているが、俺の耳には意味をなす言葉として入ってこなかった。
lines.english: Ai said something beside me, but the sounds never reached my ears as meaningful words.

lines.japanese: なぜならそこに映っていたのは──
lines.english: Because the person in that photograph was—

lines.japanese: 「こいつはぁーッ！」
lines.english: “It's her!”

lines.japanese: ――羽田小鳩。我らが守るべき姫君だった。
lines.english: —Kobato Haneda. Our princess, whom we had to protect.

lines.japanese: 「え、え？　なに突然、びっくりしたぁ……」
lines.english: “Wh-what? Why are you shouting all of a sudden? You scared me...”

lines.japanese: 「なんだよこりゃあ」
lines.english: “What the hell is this?”

lines.japanese: 急激な変化に驚いたのか、亜衣が画面と俺の顔を交互に見比べた。
lines.english: Startled by the sudden change, Ai looked back and forth between the screen and my face.

lines.japanese: 「や、だから私知らないし。ええー、なんかほら、その下の方に書き込みあるよ」
lines.english: “I told you, I don't know. Look, there's some writing farther down.”

lines.japanese: 「くっ……馬鹿な……なんだこれは……って聞いてんだァッ！」
lines.english: “Damn it... Impossible... I'm asking what the hell this is!”

lines.japanese: 瞬間、亜衣の体がびくっと震えた。
lines.english: Ai's whole body flinched.

lines.japanese: 思わず口をついて出た自らの怒声に、俺は理性を取り戻す。
lines.english: The roar that burst from my own mouth shocked me back to reason.

lines.japanese: 首の後ろにちりっとした痛みが走った。
lines.english: Pain sparked at the back of my neck.

lines.japanese: 「……あ、いや、悪い」
lines.english: “...No. Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 俺は事態が飲みこめず、しかしそれでも心配そうに俺のことを見つめている女に頭を下げた。
lines.english: I bowed to the girl who understood none of what was happening and still watched me with concern.

lines.japanese: 「も……しかして、隼人君の知り合い、なのかな」
lines.english: “Is she... someone you know?”

lines.japanese: 「ん、まあ、そんなとこ。もし他に知ってることあったら教えて」
lines.english: “Yeah. Something like that. If you know anything else, tell me.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん」
lines.english: “O-okay.”

lines.japanese: 亜衣は俺の手から携帯を受けとると、なにかのキーをかちかちと操作して、画面を動かしていく。
lines.english: Ai took the phone from my hand, clicked through several keys, and scrolled the page.

lines.japanese: 俺は昨日のことを思いだした。ゆうべ小鳩と一緒のところにＲ－ウイングのやつと出くわし、その次の日に連中の掲示板に写真があげられた──ちょっと出来すぎじゃねえか。
lines.english: I thought back to yesterday. We'd run into one of R-Wing while I was with Kobato; the next day, her photograph appeared on their message board. A little too neat.

lines.japanese: 俺は自分の迂闊さを呪った。昨日の小鳩の言葉が頭に浮かぶ。
lines.english: I cursed my carelessness. Kobato's words from yesterday rose in my mind.

lines.japanese: あぶないことはやめてください。ごもっともだクソッたれ。
lines.english: *Please don't do anything dangerous.* Sound advice, goddamn it.

lines.japanese: 「あった！　隼人君、はい」
lines.english: “Found it! Here, Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 亜衣が差しだしてきた携帯を、落ち着こうとしながらも、ひったくるような形で奪いとった。
lines.english: Trying to stay calm, I took the phone she held out with something perilously close to a snatch.

lines.japanese: 今宵、長針と短針の天空に向けて重なりし時、我が同胞は聖地へ集え。かの地、朱の禊にて咎人の罪を洗い流さん。投稿者はパトリアーク・ヨーゼフ。あのオウム野郎だ。
lines.english: *Tonight, when the long and short hands meet and point as one toward heaven, let my brethren assemble upon the holy ground. There, in an ablution of scarlet, shall we wash clean the sinner's transgression.* The poster was Patriarch Josef. That goddamn parrot.

lines.japanese: クソが。ふざけんな、よりにもよって小鳩を狙いやがった。
lines.english: Fuck him. Of all people, he'd gone after Kobato.

lines.japanese: 首の後ろに鈍い痛みがじりじりじりと広がっていく。久しく忘れていたこの感覚。
lines.english: A dull pain spread, inch by inch by inch, across the back of my neck. I hadn't felt this in a long time.

lines.japanese: 俺はその箇所を押さえて、がくりと膝をついた。
lines.english: I clutched the spot and dropped heavily to one knee.

lines.japanese: 俺がいる理由、俺が生まれた理由、俺がここにいる理由、そんなもんが頭の中に一度に流れ込んでくる。
lines.english: Why I existed. Why I had been born. Why I was here. All of it flooded into my mind at once.

lines.japanese: 一瞬、胃の中身を全部ブチ撒けちまいそうになる、クソ気色悪い空気が俺の目の前を包み込んだ。
lines.english: A sickening atmosphere swallowed everything before my eyes, so vile that for one instant I nearly emptied my stomach.

lines.japanese: “おめ……っぽ、……めったら……、ゆるさ……っぞ……”
lines.english: “You... Koba... if you hurt... won’t forg...”

lines.japanese: 「がはっ！」
lines.english: “Gah!”

lines.japanese: 俺は喉の奥に手を突っこんだ。リアルな世界でリアルのゲロを吐いてしまった方が、意識を泥流に流されるよりもはるかにましだ。
lines.english: I jammed a hand down my throat. Better to vomit actual vomit into the real world than let a mudslide sweep my consciousness away.

lines.japanese: 「かっ！　かっ、かあっ……！　げはっ！」
lines.english: “Kh! Kh, khaah... Gah!”

lines.japanese: 何度も咳き込んだが、おかげでゲロみてえな世界からは逃れることが出来た。膝においた手に力を込めて、態勢を整えようとする。
lines.english: I coughed again and again, but it got me out of that world that felt like vomit. Bracing a hand on my knee, I tried to pull myself together.

lines.japanese: 「クソッた──」
lines.english: “Goddamn—”
“...Koba... if it’s about...”

lines.japanese: 頭に浮かぶ声を認識しないよう努めた。これは声じゃねえ、俺の生まれたときの記憶で、いま現実に誰かがしゃべっているわけじゃない。
lines.english: I tried not to recognize the voice surfacing in my mind. It wasn't a voice. It was a memory from the moment I was born; nobody was speaking here in reality.

lines.japanese: 「うぜェ！　忘れろ忘れろ忘れろ！」
lines.english: “Fuck off! Forget it, forget it, forget it!”

lines.japanese: “お、ま……っかえね……だな……、ったら……て……わん……しょー……”
首を横に振って逃れようとしたが、時間を退行するかのように俺の記憶が次々に脳裏に浮かんでくる。最後に浮かんできたのは、なにも見えない……いや、そもそもからして何ものも存在しない闇の奥。
lines.english: I shook my head to escape, but memories rose one after another, as though time itself were running backward. Last came the depths of a darkness where nothing could be seen—no, where nothing had existed in the first place.

lines.japanese: “汝の敵を裁け”
lines.english: Pass judgment on your enemy.

lines.japanese: それはその場所が示すように、一切の存在理由を失った者が行きつく場所。
lines.english: As the place itself proclaimed, this was where one arrived after losing every reason to exist.

lines.japanese: “小鳩の敵を裁け”
lines.english: Pass judgment on Kobato’s enemy.

lines.japanese: 「……んだっ」
lines.english: “What...?”

lines.japanese: “去んで玉座を余に空けよ”
lines.english: Begone, and leave the throne to me.
“What the... hell... are you...?”

lines.japanese: “貴様に代わって俺が裁いてやる”
lines.english: I shall judge him in your stead.

lines.japanese: 唐突に声が聞こえてきた。これは記憶の中の音じゃない、いまこの時間で俺の脳裏に響いてくる音だ。
lines.english: The voice came without warning. This was no sound recalled from memory. It was ringing through my mind in the present moment.

lines.japanese: ただし鼓膜を通した音じゃない、意識に直接語りかけてくるこの声は……タカシか、鷲介か、それとも――
lines.english: It hadn't passed through my eardrums. This voice spoke directly to consciousness... Takashi? Shusuke? Or—

lines.japanese: 思考が混沌とし始めてから聞こえてきたその声は、徐々に周囲の声を俺から遠ざけやがて――世界の全てを奪っていった。
lines.english: The voice had begun when my thoughts dissolved into chaos. Little by little, it drove every surrounding voice farther away, until at last it stole the entire world.

lines.japanese: 俺は、濃白色の──あるいは完全なる無色の闇に呑みこまれた。
lines.english: I was swallowed by a darkness of dense white—or absolute colorlessness.

lines.japanese: 「ファルコン」
lines.english: “Falcon.”

lines.japanese: 音なき意思が、いまや空気の振動を伴わない声を以って俺に呼びかける。
lines.english: A soundless will addressed me now in a voice that stirred no air.

lines.japanese: 「そこを降りろ。怒りを呼びおこせぬ貴様にそれ以上は無理だ。貴様には爺々の呪いがかかっている」
lines.english: “Step down. Without the power to call up anger, you can go no further. The old man’s curse is upon you.”

lines.japanese: そいつはひどく尊大で傲慢な言葉を用いていたが、その声はひどく悠長で淡白で──どこか白々しかった。
lines.english: Its words were outrageously imperious and arrogant, yet the voice itself was languid, dry—and somehow false.

lines.japanese: 「誰だてめえ……！」
lines.english: “Who the hell are you...?”

lines.japanese: 「おいおいファルコン、下賎にして無力な愚弟よ、おまえは誰に向かってそんな口を利いているんだ？」
lines.english: “Come now, Falcon, my base and powerless little brother. Do you understand whom you address in that manner?”

lines.japanese: 「だから！　誰だって聞いてんだろ！」
lines.english: “That’s why I’m asking! Who the hell are you?”

lines.japanese: 「いいだろう。心して耳傾けよ。余は、グレタガルドの王だ」
lines.english: “Very well. Listen closely. I am the king of Gretagard.”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 「は、はァァ！？」
lines.english: “Wh-whaaat?!”

lines.japanese: 「臣民は余をガルーダと呼んでいた。貴様らに倣って現世での名を銘ずるなら、伊丹伽楼羅だ」
lines.english: “My subjects called me Garuda. If I must follow your example and name myself in this world, then I am Karura Itami.”

lines.japanese: 「へっ！　あァ畜生、そういうことかよ、こんなときに……」
lines.english: “Heh! Ah, goddamn it. So that's what this is. At a time like this...”

lines.japanese: 「こんなときに、くそっ、また新しい人格が増えたのか！」
lines.english: “At a time like this—shit—another new personality?”

lines.japanese: 「新しい？　ははは、馬鹿を申すな愚弟。それは違う、俺は貴様らより古くから存在していたのだ」
lines.english: “New? Ha ha ha. Speak no foolishness, little brother. You are mistaken. I existed long before any of you.”

lines.japanese: 「さあファルコン、消えゆくさだめの暗黒街の王よ。もういいだろう。我が尊名を手土産に、底知れぬ魂の冥府へ還れ」
lines.english: “Now, Falcon, king of an underworld doomed to fade. Enough. Take my august name as your parting gift and return to the fathomless netherworld of the soul.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ？　なんだそりゃ……馬鹿かおまえ、何ふざけたことぬかしてんだ」
lines.english: “Huh? What the hell is that supposed to mean...? Are you an idiot? What kind of bullshit are you spouting?”

lines.japanese: 「なに、俺が？　ふざけていると？」
lines.english: “What? You believe that I jest?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだろよ。俺と鷲介はな、たっぷり永い年月かけて、なんとかタカシと三人で≪共存≫するための秩序を築いてきたんだ。な？　いつ誰が≪コックピット≫へ入るかっつうシフトも、もうかっちり決まってんだよ」
lines.english: “Shusuke and I spent long years building an order that would finally let the three of us *coexist* with Takashi. You hear me? We've got the shifts—who enters the *Cockpit*, and when—locked down tight.”

lines.japanese: 「よう、なあ新人。ここまで安定したローテーション組めるよンなるまで、俺らがどんだけ苦労したと思ってんだオォ。なあコラ。あとからシャシャって来た若僧が、好き勝手に替われとか言ってんじゃねえぞコラ──｣
lines.english: “Listen, rookie. You have any idea how hard we worked to get a rotation this stable? Huh? Some young punk doesn't get to barge in late and demand a turn whenever he feels like it—”

lines.japanese: 「いやあ待て待て。勘違いをしてはいかんなあ、ファルコン。俺は貴様に替われなどとは言っていない」
lines.english: “Wait, wait. You must not misunderstand me, Falcon. I never asked you to change places with me.”

lines.japanese: 「失せろ。と言ったんだ」
lines.english: “I told you to disappear.”

lines.japanese: 「てめェ……」
lines.english: “You bastard...”

lines.japanese: 「失せろ。王に玉座を返還せよ。その場所は元来、余のものである」
lines.english: “Disappear. Return the throne to its king. That place was mine from the beginning.”

lines.japanese: 「ふっ、ふざけんなっつってんだろ！　そんな話、いきなり聞かされて納得できるかボケ！」
lines.english: “Q-quit screwing around! You dump that on me out of nowhere and think I'll just accept it, moron?”

lines.japanese: 「大体てめえ、うさんくせェんだよ。ろくでもねえ臭いがプンプンすんじゃねえか。てめえみたいのが≪コックピット≫入って、俺らの体使って何する気だこの野郎」
lines.english: “Besides, you’re shady as hell. You reek of trouble. What do you plan to do with our body if you get into the *Cockpit*, asshole?”

lines.japanese: 「おいおい、言わせるのか？　分かってるだろう、ファルコン。俺たちはみな、それぞれに能わぬことを為すため、それぞれに欠けたものを補うために生まれてきた存在だ」
lines.english: “Come now, will you make me say it? You understand, Falcon. Each of us was born to accomplish what the others could not and supply what the others lacked.”

lines.japanese: 「俺の存在意義は貴様らに欠けているもの。すなわち憎悪と怨嗟──爺々の言葉を借りるなら、誰かをやっつけてやりたいと思う気持ち」
lines.english: “The purpose of my existence is what you lack: hatred and resentment—or, to borrow the old man’s words, the desire to hurt someone.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！」
lines.english: “Ha!”

lines.japanese: 「何がおかしい」
lines.english: “What amuses you?”

lines.japanese: 「そうかよ、ハッ、分かったよ」
lines.english: “I see. Ha! I get it now.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、分かったよ！　じいさんがしつけえぐらい俺に抑えろ抑えろ言ってたのは、憎悪と怨嗟！　おまえのことだ！　おう、そうだろ！」
lines.english: “Yeah, I get it! The old man kept telling me to hold it down, hold it down—hatred and resentment! He meant *you*, didn’t he?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、だろうな。あの爺々には一度──偶然だが──俺が操縦桿を握った際に遭遇していたからな」
lines.english: “Indeed, he must have. The old man once encountered me—by chance—when I took the controls.”

lines.japanese: 「そして爺々が俺の存在を貴様らに伏せていた理由は、おそらく、貴様らが自らの存在をホークに隠しているのと同じ理由だったのだろう」
lines.english: “And he concealed my existence from you, most likely for the same reason you conceal your own existence from Hawk.”

lines.japanese: 「すなわち貴様らのうちの誰かが、ひとたび俺という人格の存在を認識してしまえば、俺の存在は格段に強固なものとなる。いまこうして、俺と貴様とのあいだで明確な意思の疎通が可能となったように」
lines.english: “In other words, once any one of you recognized the existence of a personality called me, my existence would grow vastly more solid. Just as clear communication between you and me has now become possible.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえ。ごちゃごちゃうるせえ。いまさらおまえみてえな協調性のねえやつはお呼びじゃねンだよ。≪コックピット≫を独占するつもりなら尚更だ、穴蔵の奥にすっこんでろ。おら、世界が平和でありますように！」
lines.english: “Shut up. Enough of this crap. We don’t need some uncooperative bastard like you showing up now. Especially if you mean to monopolize the *Cockpit*. Crawl back into your deepest hole. Here—*May peace prevail on Earth!*”

lines.japanese: 「んん？　なんだそれは。爺々のまじないか。小賢しいな」
lines.english: “Hmm? What’s that? One of the old man’s charms? A cheap little trick.”

lines.japanese: 「世界が平和でありますように世界が平和でありますように世界が平和でありますように！」
lines.english: “*May peace prevail on Earth, may peace prevail on Earth, may peace prevail on Earth!*”

lines.japanese: 「やれやれ、盗人の分際で呆れた執着心だ。まだそこに留まるつもりなのか、貴様は」
lines.english: “Good grief. Astonishing tenacity for a thief. Do you still mean to remain there?”

lines.japanese: 「世界が平和でありますように世界が平和でありますように世界が平和でありますように！」
lines.english: “*May peace prevail on Earth, may peace prevail on Earth, may peace prevail on Earth!*”

lines.japanese: 「ほう……大した成果ではないか、そのまじない。こいつは弱った、暗黒の引力がふたたび俺を呼びこもうとしているぞ」
lines.english: “Oh...? That charm is remarkably effective. How troublesome. The gravity of darkness is drawing me back in.”

lines.japanese: 「世界が平和でありますように世界が平和でありますように世界が平和でありますように！」
lines.english: “*May peace prevail on Earth, may peace prevail on Earth, may peace prevail on Earth!*”

lines.japanese: 「だがなファルコン、奈落の名に懸けて、俺がその玉座に返り咲く日は近いぞ。それは一度でも這いいずる機会を与えてしまった貴様の遺漏だ」
lines.english: “But Falcon, by the name of the abyss, the day I reclaim that throne is near. Giving me even one chance to crawl forth was your fatal oversight.”

lines.japanese: 「クク、俺は深い竪穴の際に手をかけて窺っていよう。愚弟よ、次に玉座を下りたときが貴様の最期──そして栄えある王の凱旋だ」
lines.english: “Heh. I shall wait with my hands upon the brink of the deep shaft. Foolish brother, the next time you leave the throne shall be your end—and the glorious return of its king.”

lines.japanese: 「……くん！　どうしたの、ねえ、隼人君っ！」
lines.english: “...yato! What’s wrong? Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 白い闇が晴れていた。まるで教会での≪面談≫が終わったときのように忽然と。
lines.english: The white darkness had cleared, vanishing as abruptly as when an *Interview* at the church ended.

lines.japanese: 視界が開けてくると、かすかな寒気と温かな感覚に包まれていた。頭上には、なだらかで硬い感触。
lines.english: As sight returned, faint cold and gentle warmth enclosed me. Above my head was something firm, with a soft curve.

lines.japanese: 「隼人君！」
lines.english: “Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 「あれ……いま俺、どうしてた……？」
lines.english: “Huh...? What was I just doing...?”

lines.japanese: 「わかんない。なんか急に倒れちゃって、私ちょおパニくっちゃって、でも目さめてよかった……あ、どうしよう、救急車呼ぶ？」
lines.english: “I don't know. You just collapsed, and I totally freaked out, but thank God you're awake... Oh—what do I do? Should I call an ambulance?”

lines.japanese: 「いや……いい……」
lines.english: “No... Don’t...”

lines.japanese: 亜衣はみっともねえ顔をして俺の顔を見下ろしていた。
lines.english: Ai looked down at me with a wretched expression.

lines.japanese: ああ、そうか……。
lines.english: Oh. I see...

lines.japanese: 分かった、思いだした。
lines.english: I understood. I remembered.

lines.japanese: なんで俺がここにいるのか。俺がいつまで居られるのか。
lines.english: Why I was here. How long I was allowed to stay.

lines.japanese: ああ、俺は飛びだせ青春なんてしてる場合じゃない。
lines.english: Right. This was no time for some *Go Forth, Youth!* nonsense.

lines.japanese: 俺がいっちょ前に人並の幸せをつかもうなんざお笑い草だ。
lines.english: The thought of me reaching out for an ordinary person's share of happiness was a joke.

lines.japanese: 分かった。
lines.english: I understood.

lines.japanese: おまえは分からないかもしれないが、それは俺じゃない別の誰かにでも聞いてくれ。
lines.english: Maybe you don't understand. Ask somebody else, then. Somebody who isn't me.

lines.japanese: 「うし」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese: 俺は体をゆっくりと起こす。
lines.english: I slowly raised myself.

lines.japanese: 「う、動かないほうがいいよ……」
lines.english: “Y-you shouldn’t move...”

lines.japanese: 「悪りい」
lines.english: “Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「俺さ、これから急いで行かなくちゃいけないところできたから」
lines.english: “Something's come up. Somewhere I have to get to fast.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「なんか周りの通行人こっち見てるし。あとのこと頼むわ」
lines.english: “People passing by are staring at us. I'll leave you to handle the rest.”

lines.japanese: 「え、頼むとかじゃなくて、私どーすんの？」
lines.english: “What do you mean, leave it to me? What am *I* supposed to do?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ、これやるよ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. You can have this.”

lines.japanese: 俺は手の中にあったレモンティーを亜衣に放りなげると、指定された場所へ向かって走りはじめた。
lines.english: I tossed Ai the lemon tea in my hand and began running toward the appointed place.

lines.japanese: 悪い、これでもお前には感謝してんだ。さっきちょっとだけ、ほんのちょっとだけど、おまえと一緒にいるの楽しかった。
lines.english: Sorry. For what it's worth, I am grateful. Back there, just for a little while—only a little—I had fun being with you.

lines.japanese: からここ、からここ、こんここん……
lines.english: Clacka-kok, clacka-kok, konka-kon...

lines.japanese: 走る体は、冬の外気を集めてより一層熱く感じられた。
lines.english: The running body gathered the winter air and burned all the hotter for it.

lines.japanese: その血液のリズムは、響きわたるアフリカ太鼓の音に合わせて昂ぶっていくかのようだった。
lines.english: The rhythm of its blood seemed to climb in answer to the resounding African drums.

lines.japanese: 道中、俺はモンキのスポーツ用品売り場へ駆けこんで試合用のバンテージを買った。
lines.english: On the way, I ran into Monki's sporting-goods floor and bought competition hand wraps.

lines.japanese: こぶしを痛めないための準備をするのはどのくらいぶりだろう。俺もいよいよ切羽詰まってるんだ、大目に見てくれよ、じいさん。
lines.english: How long had it been since I'd bothered protecting my fists? I'm finally backed into a corner here. Let this one slide, old man.
